title: Tick-mark minutes
description: Trades the spelled-out "min" for a terse apostrophe (3', 12') and compresses the hours row into "1h04" — a denser, timetable-style notation. The apostrophe and the hour digits both stay inside the existing eta/eta-unit elements, no new fields needed.
baseline_ref: app/components/ArrivalRow.vue eta formatting ('N min' / 'H h M min'); .arrival-row__eta, .arrival-row__eta-unit

changes.intent: Swap the unit text for a compact tick mark on plain-minute rows.
changes.detail: For rows under 60 minutes (excluding 'ahora'), render .arrival-row__eta-unit content as "'" instead of "min" — e.g. 3' and 12'. No change to the numeric portion of .arrival-row__eta.

changes.intent: Compress the ≥60min format into a single terse token instead of two spaced numbers with two unit words.
changes.detail: For the hours branch, render as `${hours}` + .arrival-row__eta-unit("h") + zero-padded `${String(minutes).padStart(2,'0')}` directly appended with no separating space and no second 'min' unit — i.e. "1" + unit"h" + "04", displaying as 1h04. This keeps the ≥60min case visually distinct from the sub-60 apostrophe format.

changes.intent: The apostrophe should hug its number tighter than the word 'min' did.
